title: SEO and content opportunities after General Surgery Phase C

highest_growth_opportunities.why: New ACS coverage plus existing appendix codes supports high-intent searches like open appendectomy CPT, laparoscopic appendectomy CPT, ruptured appendicitis billing, and drainage/abscess scenarios.

highest_growth_opportunities.topic: Open abdomen and re-exploration coding hub
highest_growth_opportunities.why: 49014 is a new high-value ACS code with real surgeon search intent around second-look laparotomy, open abdomen, washout, and staged abdominal closure.
49020 and 49040 create content surface for abscess drainage, peritoneal abscess, pelvic abscess, and open vs percutaneous drainage searches.
20100/20101 fill trauma/ACS content gaps and support high-intent searches for penetrating wound exploration, neck/chest/abdomen wound exploration, and operative trauma documentation.

highest_growth_opportunities.topic: Foreign body removal emergency surgery hub
highest_growth_opportunities.why: 49402 plus ENT/eye foreign body ACS codes support broad urgent-care/ED/surgery searches. Needs careful grouping to avoid diluting surgical relevance.

highest_growth_opportunities.topic: Coverage dashboard as internal editorial roadmap
highest_growth_opportunities.why: Remaining gaps are now concentrated in Breast, Soft Tissue, Stomach residuals, Rib Fixation, Hernia, Spleen, and Appendix residuals. Prioritize pages where missing-code count and surgeon search intent overlap.
